tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Critical points are the zeros of the gradient]

↗ def:gradient ↗ lem:gradient-characterization ↗ lem:flat-bijective

Let $(M,g)$ be a finite-dimensional Riemannian manifold, $f\colon M\to \mathbb R$ smooth, and $p\in M$. Then \[ \operatorname {grad}f|_p=0\quad \Longleftrightarrow \quad df_p=0. \] Thus $p$ is regular precisely when $\operatorname {grad}f|_p\ne 0$.

Proof

↗ lem:gradient-characterization ↗ lem:flat-bijective \sketch If the gradient vanishes, (2.14) gives $df_p(w)=0$ for every $w$. Conversely, $df_p=0$ makes $\operatorname {grad}f|_p$ orthogonal to every vector; equivalently, its flat image is zero, and injectivity of $\flat $ proves that the gradient vanishes.

□
